'''Hallon''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who as a child served as a [[scrumrat]] in the [[White Worms]] gang on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]]. He worked as a [[thief]] for the gang, as his small sized allowed him slip through spaces where older thieves could not fit. In [[13 BBY]], he was present when the scrumrat [[Han Solo|Han]] escaped from Proxima in the [[Den of the White Worms]].

==Biography==
Hallon was [[human]] [[Gender|male]] from the [[planet]] [[Corellia]] who served as a [[scrumrat]] in the [[White Worms]] gang of [[Coronet City]]. His duties for the gang included catching pests and working as a [[thief]], as his small size allowed him to fit through spaces too narrow for older thieves.<ref name="SoloOG" />

In the [[Standard year|year]] [[13 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the events in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' that take place on [[Corellia]] to six years after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the formation of the Empire to [[19 BBY]]; therefore, the events on Corellia in ''Solo'' must take place in [[13 BBY]].</ref> Hallon was present in the den when fellow scrumrat [[Han Solo|Han]] was brought before [[Lady]] [[Proxima]], leader of the gang. Han, who had returned from a trade with no goods for Proxima, used a rock to break a shutter behind the gang leader and bathe her in light, which burned her skin. Using the distraction, Han then pushed through the other scrumrats and escaped.<ref name="Solo" />

==Personality and traits==
Hallon disobeyed orders from the gang and let pests that he caught in the den go alive.<ref name="SoloOG" /> He had fair skin, [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], and green [[eye]]s.<ref name="Solo" />

==Equipment==
Hallon wore a brown [[Salt|brine]]-stained [[Clothing|shirt]] as well as a light-filtering headband and a pair of work [[goggles]] with magnifying lenses.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hallon first appeared in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Solo" /> The character was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SoloOG" />
